review_mode: Independent author-separated source review and read-only metadata/byte audit; no test rerun or runtime launch

preparation_review.key_dependencies: The old prepare implementation reads only method and L_D from the template; the new cache uses exactly those keys and the identical frozen geometry arrays.
preparation_review.arithmetic_and_iteration_order: Eigenvalue ordering, coefficient insertion/accumulation, dense action, tail accumulation, reconstruction check and corrected-signal operations retain the old formulas and order.
preparation_review.mutability: Input references and read-only flags are checked; cached dense/operator/tail arrays are read-only, coefficient mappings are protected, and returned lists/component dictionaries are fresh. Qiskit basis circuits remain mutable objects confined to the driver; reviewed builders compose copies and the artificial parameter/basis checks detect no mutation.
preparation_review.lifetime: One common object is local to each geometry in the candidate generator. No persistent scientific cache or cross-run reuse is introduced. A previous geometry may briefly overlap next-geometry construction; the 30 MiB figure is a per-geometry cached-array bound, excluding basis metadata, scratch, original inputs and transition overlap.
preparation_review.concurrency: Preparation and candidate generation run in the single driver. Worker futures receive circuits, not GeometryPreparation objects; queue bounds and publication order are unchanged.

save_paths_reviewed: Initialization emits an empty version-0 delta.
reserve emits the one new RESERVED reservation key before worker submission.
complete publishes the record first, then the one COMPLETE entry and its own reservation change; cache reuse emits only the entry.

limits_and_not_evaluated: The 218-template array comparison uses ten old method/split preparations, consistent with the reviewed old dependency set; it is not 218 full production wrapper executions.

Wrapper and signal equality use representative artificial templates and fixed seeds, including one dense complex 256x256 parameter case. Real Gaussian/OpenFermion preparation and actual molecular inputs were not executed.
Production compiler output equivalence, worker occupancy, end-to-end runtime and measured production speedup remain unverified.
Changing SOURCE changes source-bound candidate/trajectory identities; artificial same-seed equality does not authorize mixing old/new-SOURCE random results.
Fresh CPU, memory, PSI/OOM, filesystem, inode and quota launch observations were not performed by this review.
remaining_approval_and_gates: Explicit cumulative output-cap amendment and authorization for one fixed-new-SOURCE attempt remain required; unchanged prior environment/CPU/observer/actual-cap approvals are retained.
After any approved cap amendment: update its enforcement gate, freeze a new SOURCE, rebind and independently review before a fresh one-shot launch.
No refund/reset, automatic retry, input regeneration or next stage is authorized.
